title: From an empty shop to the first sale
target: A first-day sequence for Supermarket Simulator that takes the shop from empty shelves to a paying customer, using only behaviour the game defines.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with at least one shelf
A checkout you can stand at

steps.do: Put stock on one shelf and stand back to watch it.
steps.because: a shelf refills an empty slot and sells what it holds (SpawnProductOnEmptyShelf)

steps.do: Open up and stay at the till for the first customers.
steps.because: paying is an explicit checkout and payment step (StartCashierCheckout, FinishCheckout)

steps.do: Watch where people walk once they are inside.
steps.because: customers follow a path and wait in a queue rather than standing where you place them (WaypointNavigator, Queue)

steps.do: Tidy up at the end of the day.
steps.because: cleanliness is tracked against the shop's standing (CleaningState, CleaningReputationManager)

commonMistakes: Leaving the till while a queue forms.
Ignoring mess because it looks harmless.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
